text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tapping into every ounce of her<n>strength, Grass
Wonder prevails over<n>Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Scores of fans impacted by her<n>running now have
high expectations<n>for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa visits Grass Wonder<n>after the race
and issues yet another<n>challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with Silence Suzuka also<n>scheduled to run, the
Mainichi Okan is<n>shaping up to become an intense
race.
